kind: Full job through the hosted UI on PayPal Sandbox (test money), with a Sandbox personal buyer approving in PayPal's own checkout
deployment: https://assay-34-59-154-73.sslip.io (Google Cloud VM, five services, separate databases)
steps: Merchant created the agreement in the hosted workspace
Buyer accepted the terms and approved the PayPal hold in Sandbox checkout
Demo provider registered ten jobs using pre-generated LTX-Video clips: seven delivered, one archived but never published, two never rendered
Hosted AI investigation cited the records and identified clip 08 as archived but unpublished
Merchant approved restoring the archived original for clip 08 (no new render)
Server built the exact review; merchant approved one capture

paypal.note: The unused $10.00 was never captured. It is not a refund.

webhook_signature: verified through PayPal's verify-webhook-signature API before the event is stored

kernel_playback.note: A cloud Chromium outside Assay's network fetched each delivered clip from the public buyer route, matched its SHA-256 with the archived original, and played it. Replay links are signed and are kept out of this file.

signed_statement.verified_with: the public key served at /v1/statements/keys, checked outside the deployment

observed_issues: The first AI reassessment after the restore failed (assessment_unavailable_or_invalid) and the review waited; a manual re-run succeeded. No money moved while the AI was unavailable.
The investigation page did not refresh by itself while clips were archiving; a reload showed the current state.
limits: Sandbox only. Clips are pre-generated LTX-Video outputs reused by the demo provider, not a live provider job for this batch.
